title: touchiroa orientalis
intro: Touchiroa orientalis, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family native to China and other parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Touchiroa orientalis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of Touchiroa orientalis include ferulic acid, coumarins, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
